name: Ayşe Demir
bio:
Ayşe Demir's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for mechanics, nurtured by her father's small automotive repair shop in Istanbul. She excelled in engineering studies, earning a reputation for innovative solutions and meticulous attention to detail. After graduating, Ayşe joined a local racing team, quickly rising through the ranks to become a sought-after engineer known for her ability to optimize car performance under pressure.

Her approach to chief engineering is deeply rooted in a holistic understanding of the vehicle, blending technical expertise with a keen awareness of driver needs. Ayşe excels at data analysis, using telemetry to identify areas for improvement and working closely with the team to implement changes. What sets her apart is her ability to inspire and motivate her team, fostering a collaborative environment where creativity and problem-solving thrive. She joined Akkodis ASP Team three years ago, bringing with her a reputation for reliability and innovation.

Ayşe is particularly skilled at balancing short-term gains with long-term development, ensuring that the team not only performs well in current races but also invests in the future. Her visionary approach is highly respected within the paddock, and she is known for spotting talented young engineers and nurturing their growth.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Ayşe is a woman of medium build with a focused gaze that conveys both intelligence and determination.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical diagrams and observations.
Insists on brewing her own strong Turkish coffee every morning, believing it enhances focus.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought, a sound her team has come to associate with impending breakthroughs.
